questions.q: Why is democracy considered better than other forms of government in producing an accountable and legitimate government?
answer: Democracy is preferred over dictatorship or monarchy mainly because it produces a government that is accountable, responsive and legitimate.

answer.text: A democratic government is answerable to the people, who elect it through regular free and fair elections. Citizens have the right to examine how decisions are taken, which makes the government transparent and open to scrutiny.
Democracy is the people's own government, chosen by them, so it enjoys wide acceptance. Surveys show that even the poor and less educated support democracy as the best form of government.
Because decisions are made after discussion and following proper procedure, they may be slower but are more acceptable and effective, and mistakes can be corrected.

answer: For these reasons democracy stands above other forms of government.

questions.q: Examine the record of democracy in reducing economic inequality and poverty.
answer: While democracy succeeds in giving political equality, its record on economic equality is mixed.

answer.text: In a democracy each citizen has one vote of equal value, giving everyone equal political standing. Yet in economic terms a small number of people are very rich while a large number remain poor, so wealth is very unevenly shared.

Democracies have not been very successful in reducing this economic inequality and poverty. In many democracies the poor form a large section, and their concerns are not always adequately addressed by governments.
Still, the poor value their right to vote and continue to press for a fairer share, keeping the pressure on governments to act.

answer: Thus reducing inequality remains an unfinished but important task of democracy.

questions.q: How does democracy accommodate social diversity and reduce the chance of conflict?

answer.text: is well suited to societies with many divisions because it offers a peaceful way to handle differences.

list: It lets diverse groups express their views and interests freely and compete for power through elections
It provides mechanisms to negotiate differences and share power rather than settle them by force

answer.text: But success depends on how democracy is practised.

list: No group should be permanently excluded from power, and majorities must work with minorities
When diversity is accommodated and majorities do not dominate, democracy builds harmony out of difference

questions.q: How does democracy promote the dignity and freedom of the individual, and why is this its strongest outcome?

answer.text: is founded on the political equality of all citizens, and its greatest achievement is upholding human dignity and freedom.

list: It gives every citizen an equal vote and equal standing before the law, regardless of caste, religion, wealth or sex
It has strengthened the claims of women and disadvantaged groups to equal treatment and respect

answer.text: Dignity and freedom are its core promise.

list: Citizens can express themselves, question their rulers and correct mistakes peacefully
Even where democracy falls short on other counts, its guarantee of equal dignity keeps its ideals alive and worth striving for
